description: Read recent native USDC transfers into and out of a wallet on Base mainnet, including amounts, timestamps and transaction hashes. Optional limit and UTC time window bound the returned history. wallet_address must use the exact EIP-55 checksum. Reads public chain data only. Treasury arguments never accept private keys, signatures or transaction instructions; these tools cannot sign, submit transactions, transfer funds or spend. POST /api/treasury-flows. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base mainnet using x402 exact, under the existing shared 10 signed-wallet free calls over rolling 30 days. API access billing is separate from wallet visibility: the existing access layer processes caller-supplied payment and wallet-proof headers only. X-Wever-Wallet-Proof must bind to the exact JSON arguments and this API path, not /mcp. The inspected wallet need not be the access payer. Read /api/treasury-contract and the backend 402 body for schemas, coverage and billing terms.

end_time.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp, for example 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. Start is inclusive and end is exclusive; maximum window 366 days. Defaults to the current time.

start_time.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp, for example 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. Start is inclusive and end is exclusive; maximum window 366 days. Defaults to 30 days before end_time.

wallet_address.description: Public Base wallet address in its exact EIP-55 checksum spelling. No ownership proof or secrets belong in tool arguments.

name: wever_treasury-flows
title: Treasury flows
